rundown: Squadron beat Blue 127-105 at Pontchartrain Center in Kenner, LA in front of 1,767. Squadron led 62-59 at the half and never looked back. The 4th quarter decided it: Squadron won it 36-21.
Leading the way — Blue: Zhaire Smith 25 pts; Robert McCray V 6 ast; Dariq Whitehead 6 reb. Squadron: Julian Reese 30 pts, 18 reb; Markquis Nowell 7 ast.
Where Squadron won it: they shot 33% from three to 31%, won the boards 58-24 and had 21 assists to 20.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 16, 11:59 AM ET. It had Blue 28% and Squadron 72%, projecting Blue 98.8 – Squadron 105.9 (204.7 total, Squadron by 7).

Final: Blue 105 – Squadron 127. Right winner: it had Squadron at 72%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Blue came in with a 4% above average attack and a 10% leakier than average defense (1-4, 93.4 scored and 103 allowed a game over 5 games), worth about 10 and 10 games of evidence. Projected to score 98.8, they scored 105 (+6.2 points, 6% over); projected to allow 105.9, they allowed 127 (+21.1 points, 20% over).

Squadron came in with a 7% above average attack and a 8% leakier than average defense (1-1, 104.5 scored and 101.5 allowed a game over 2 games), worth about 8 and 8 games of evidence. Projected to score 105.9, they scored 127 (+21.1 points, 20% over); projected to allow 98.8, they allowed 105 (+6.2 points, 6% over).

The bigger miss was Squadron's scoring (+21.1 points against projection); both sides outscored their projections, so the game ran hotter than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 232 against 204.7 projected (+27.3), about the 96th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±16).

Margin: Squadron by 22 against Squadron by 7 projected, about the 89th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin; there were no odds to check the projection against.

The projection missed by a lot, so those flags likely mattered here.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.144 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +14.1 points. It counts toward Hoops+ scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 64 graded Hoops+ games the algo now scales scoring ×1.011 and gives home teams -0.8 points. Team corrections so far: Blue attack ×0.973, defense ×0.986 (5 games); Squadron attack ×1.005, defense ×0.988 (3 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 15 points), no bet.
